participants.role: Overdraft facility holder — passive recipient of automated review outcome

interaction_phases.interaction: No direct interaction. Review triggered automatically by batch scheduler 30 days before facility expiry.
No direct interaction. Credit bureau refresh and behavioural analysis run in background.
No direct interaction. Persistent debt screening runs against transaction history.
No direct interaction. Review decision made automatically.
Receives notification of overdraft review outcome. Views updated overdraft terms in app/online banking. For modifications or withdrawals: receives detailed explanation and may contact support.

projections.projection_rule: Current overdraft limit, APR, and expiry date displayed in account overview and overdraft management section. Updated after review decision.
Review decision (renewed/modified/withdrawn) displayed in notifications and overdraft section. For modifications: old and new terms shown side by side.
Customer's own credit score visible in credit score section (separate feature). The specific score used in the overdraft review decision is NOT surfaced — only the outcome.
projections.masking_rule: Review decision outcome only; underlying credit grade and affordability score not disclosed

projections.projection_rule: If in persistent debt: customer receives clear explanation of what persistent debt means, how much they have paid in interest vs principal, and options to reduce overdraft reliance. FCA CONC 6.7 requires this communication.

notifications.content: Your overdraft facility has been renewed. Your limit remains £{limit} at {apr}% APR. No action is required.
Your overdraft facility terms have been updated. Your new limit is £{new_limit} at {new_apr}% APR, effective from {effective_date}. See your app for full details.

notifications.channel: Push notification + in-app + email + letter (registered post)
notifications.content: We are writing to let you know that your overdraft facility will be removed on {withdrawal_date}. You have 30 days to make arrangements. If you need help managing your finances, free debt advice is available from StepChange (0800 138 1111) or Citizens Advice.

Over the past 18 months, you have paid more in overdraft interest and charges than you have repaid in overdraft borrowing. This is called persistent debt. We want to help you reduce your reliance on your overdraft. Here are your options: [repayment plan / reduced limit / debt advice].

participants.role: Manual review escalation for edge cases (persistent debt intervention, customer complaint about review outcome)

interaction_phases.interaction: Reviews escalated overdraft review cases where automated decision is borderline or customer has raised a complaint about a previous modification/withdrawal. Can override automated decision within policy limits.

projections.projection_rule: Full credit bureau data, affordability score, credit grade, and behavioural analysis surfaced to credit analyst via internal portal.

notifications.content: Overdraft review for account {account_id} requires manual review. Reason: {escalation_reason}.
